projects.name: Progressive GAN
projects.summary: PyTorch implementation of Progressive GANs for stable, high-quality image synthesis.
description: Implemented Nvidia’s 'Progressive Growing of GANs' in PyTorch, achieving high training stability on Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10.
Published a Pythonic package for ProGAN, simplifying workflows to ~3 lines of code for rapid experimentation.

projects.name: Palette Net
projects.summary: Autoencoder-based image recoloring system that applies custom color palettes to generate diverse, stylized outputs.
description: Built an Autoencoder-based deep learning model to recolor images using custom palettes, generating diverse high-quality variations.
Curated and pre-processed a 40,000-image dataset with augmentation to overcome public data scarcity.

projects.name: GitHub SRM
projects.summary: Institute-wide portal of three Next.js apps automating project initiation, collaboration, and repo bootstrapping with CI/CD.
description: Developed a web portal with three Next.js applications to streamline project initiation and foster collaboration within the institute.
Automated the project lifecycle from idea submission to team formation and repository setup, including pre-configured repos with standards and CI/CD pipelines.

projects.name: Expense Dashboard
projects.summary: Backend + dashboard that ingests statements and vendor data to auto-categorize expenses with faster queries.
description: Automated ~90% of personal expense tracking across banks and vendors by parsing statements, scraping vendor data, and fuzzy matching to transactions.
Improved query performance by 2x and resolved data consistency issues by moving from SQLite to a MongoDB schema optimized for transactional data.

projects.name: Maze Solver
projects.summary: C++ maze generator and optimal path visualizer using DFS and Dijkstra, running in real time.
description: Implemented a DFS-based maze generation algorithm producing solvable mazes across 50+ randomized layouts.
Built a shortest-path solver with Dijkstra’s algorithm, enabling real-time optimal path visualization in ~10ms.
